entries.zh: 工程师比较了各种燃料的产热性能。

entries.en: The town held a bicentenary celebration in the square.
entries.zh: 镇上在广场举办了二百周年庆典。

entries.en: A loud neigh came from the stable.
entries.zh: 马厩里传来一声响亮的马嘶。

entries.en: A sealed bottle of absinthe stood behind the bar.
entries.zh: 酒吧柜台后放着一瓶密封的苦艾酒。

entries.en: The visitor selected a language on the touchscreen.
entries.zh: 访客在触摸屏上选择了一种语言。

entries.en: Her waxen face stood out against the dark pillow.
entries.zh: 她蜡白的脸在深色枕头上格外显眼。

entries.en: We watched the rain from the sheltered loggia.
entries.zh: 我们在有遮蔽的敞廊里看雨。

entries.en: The shop refunded the accidental overpayment.
entries.zh: 商店退还了意外多付的款项。

entries.en: The team held a postmortem after the failed launch.
entries.zh: 发射失败后，团队进行了事后检讨。

entries.en: Her work connected engineering with experimental biomedicine.
entries.zh: 她的工作把工程学与实验生物医学联系起来。

entries.en: His slouchy posture made the formal suit look untidy.
entries.zh: 他松垮的姿态让正式西装也显得不整齐。

entries.en: The sun beat unrelentingly on the empty road.
entries.zh: 太阳无情地炙烤着空荡荡的道路。

entries.en: The costumer adjusted the actor's heavy velvet cloak.
entries.zh: 戏服制作师调整了演员厚重的天鹅绒斗篷。

entries.en: The invoice listed a hundredweight of coal.
entries.zh: 发票上列有一英担煤。

entries.en: The skewness of the frame was visible beside the straight doorway.
entries.zh: 框架紧挨笔直的门口，其偏斜明显可见。

entries.en: Their congeniality made the long journey pleasant.
entries.zh: 他们意气相投，使长途旅行十分愉快。

entries.en: His edginess increased as the departure time approached.
entries.zh: 出发时间临近时，他越来越紧张急躁。
